notes.title: Thanks Merlin Demo (Update)
notes.content:
[b]Here’s what we’ve done:[/b]

[list]
[*]  Made the cutscene skippable
[*]  Added automatic pickup for the laser pistol "Gun-Boy"
[*]  Changed the interaction button to "E"
[*]  Added a UI with active button icons "E", "1", "3" for the pistol and flashlight
[*]  Enabled medkit pickup while holding the pistol
[*]  Fixed interaction when picking up a medkit (now you can't shoot the medkit with the pistol, but you can pick it up)
[*]  Increased high-interest zones for Chummy Tummy and reduced the pause between waiting and chasing
[*]  Removed unnecessary text from locations that could confuse the player  
[*]  Reduced the issue with the collision of the sphere behind which the medkit is hidden
[*]  Added decals to highlight points of interest like the "flashlight"
[*]  Added hints/signs in dead ends
[*]  Added spiders everywhere there are spheres
[*]  Added a "joke" with the Christmas tree
[*]  Slightly dimmed the lights in the shooting range room
[*]  Added decals to the environment in all rooms
[/list]
